system.description:
You evoke a blob of inky blackness that hangs in the air, swallowing all light and smothering sound — a heavy morass to everyone caught inside it.

Spend a Blood Trait to conjure a sphere of darkness roughly ten feet across; for one additional Blood Trait you may place it out of your line of sight, so long as it is within 50 feet. Victims gain the Negative Physical Trait Clumsy, and mortals with five or fewer current Physical Traits may be strangled exactly as under Shadow Play (the penalties and strangling are not cumulative between the two powers). Inside, every light but fire is extinguished and sound is muffled: victims suffer total-darkness penalties, losing two Traits on challenge resolution and being forced to retest any one successful challenge. Heightened Senses and Eyes of the Beast each remove one penalty Trait but not the forced retest. With full concentration you can drift the cloud at a walking pace. It lasts a scene or an hour, or until you dispel it.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
